sources.snippet: 🚀 SenseNova U1 is a new series of native multimodal models that unifies multimodal understanding, reasoning, and generation within a monolithic architecture. It marks a fundamental paradigm shift in multimodal AI: from modality integration to true unification. Rather than relying on adapters to translate between modalities, SenseNova U1 models think-and-act across language and vision ...
